title: Exclude non-translation correction models
description: Fail closed on scale, rotation, skew, warping, per-label offsets, and other non-translation correction in schemas, imports, derivation requests, scenes, profiles, and UI unless issue 09 is formally reopened and resolved with repeated physical evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Public and persisted correction contracts expose only whole-sheet x/y translation
Imports and derivation requests containing unsupported correction fields are refused with stable reasons
UI offers no controls or claims for scale, rotation, skew, warping, or per-label correction
Extension requires an explicit resolved policy/version change rather than silently accepting extra fields

steps.details: Check profile, import, derivation, scene, renderer, and form contracts for unsupported degrees of freedom.
Reject unknown or named non-translation correction fields at all untrusted and persistence boundaries.
Ensure review and blocked-state UI discloses x/y-only scope and exposes no non-translation controls.
Submit scale, rotation, skew, warp, per-label, matrix, and unknown correction fixtures and verify structured refusal without mutation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; audit narrow surfaces and add hostile schema fixtures only.

PHYSICAL BLOCKERS (source issues, not generated task IDs): issue 13 must establish available materials, issue 07 must establish a repeated-observation baseline, and issue 09 must establish evidence thresholds and correction policy.
BLOCKED: issue 09 is unresolved and no repeated physical evidence supports additional correction freedoms.
Do not make dormant unsupported fields that imports could later activate accidentally.
